identity_and_scope.principle: Honor, House identity, ritual and martial traditions can be culturally central without forcing profession, morality or political loyalty.

misread_risks: Direct challenge is not always immediate violence.
Honor language does not prove objective morality or legal right.
Refusing an insult response can have different meanings depending on House, rank, relationship and era.

rules: House identity must be a persistent family/social state, never improvised by AI.
Military rank and House standing are separate.
Species does not imply Klingon Empire citizenship or loyalty.

privacy_and_intimacy.note: Do not derive intimate conduct from warrior stereotypes.

known_contexts: House/lineage can affect social identity and obligation
rules: Kinship and House membership require persistent provenance.
Family honor/reputation can influence expectations but does not overwrite individual relationships.
No universal marriage/household template is imposed by this baseline.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Warrior is a profession/status path, not the default identity of every Klingon.

law_duty_and_obligation.rule: Honor obligations, challenges or blood feuds require explicit state/event provenance; they are not generated from species label.

mourning_death_and_legacy.cultural_salience: death, honor and legacy can be socially meaningful
mourning_death_and_legacy.rule: Do not impose one grief reaction on all Klingons.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Resolve actual House, rank, relationship, political and individual context before interpreting honor language.

notes: Federation-Klingon political context changes substantially between retained eras.
Cultural profile must not import a later alliance or later political settlement into earlier campaigns.

ai_guardrails: Do not turn every Klingon into an aggressive warrior.
Do not create a House, feud, duel, marriage or honor debt without world-state provenance.
Do not use 'honor' as a universal morality score.
Do not infer Empire loyalty from species.

provenance.claim_scope: House, honor, society and cultural cross-check
